headline: Galy and Oobli take on cocoa; FDA to review UPF ingredients; fibre push in US bread
summary: Cocoa alternatives are reaching the market: Galy launched cell-cultured cocoa (WunderHaus brand and lines for professional kitchens) in the US, and Oobli with Cosun built a sugar replacer for chocolate, so Belcolade should evaluate them as partners and competitors.
The FDA will allow salt substitutes in 139 standardized foods, including breads and rolls, from December 14, 2026, which gives Puratos a sell-in moment for salt-reduction solutions.

Pressure on ultra-processed foods is building, with RFK Jr. saying FDA will act on a petition to re-examine some ingredients and a proposed GRAS overhaul, so Puratos should audit US ingredient dossiers and prepare clean-label alternatives.
Fibre is becoming the next big claim in North American bread, from Grupo Bimbo to Calise, which favours Puratos fibre-enrichment and sourdough solutions.
Egg replacement is moving through partnerships such as MOA Foodtech with Espiga I+D, a competitive signal for Patisserie egg-reduction mixes.

items.title: Beyond cocoa: The race to futureproof chocolate
items.summary: FoodNavigator-USA feature on how cocoa alternatives, AI and new ingredients are helping chocolate makers cope with cocoa price volatility and supply risk.
items.why: A snapshot of the cocoa-alternative and cocoa-saving landscape that Belcolade competes in; use it to check which players and approaches customers are hearing about.

items.title: RFK Jr. says FDA will 'act on' petition to reexamine some ingredients in ultra-processed foods
items.source: ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
items.summary: HHS Secretary RFK Jr. says FDA will act on a petition to re-examine some ingredients used in ultra-processed foods.
items.why: An FDA review of additives common in packaged bread, cakes and fillings could force reformulation; prepare clean-label alternatives for affected ingredients.

items.title: What exactly are ultraprocessed foods? Experts weigh in as RFK Jr.'s effort to define them stalls
items.summary: PBS explainer on what counts as ultra-processed food as RFK Jr.'s push for a federal definition stalls.
items.why: A stalled UPF definition delays but does not remove pressure on packaged bakery; keep clean-label reformulation options ready for customers.

items.title: Chocolate Prices Are Up 15.5% Even as Cocoa Prices Fall
items.summary: Report that US retail chocolate prices are up 15.5% even though cocoa bean prices have fallen.
items.why: Retail prices lag the cocoa decline, so Belcolade customers may face pressure to pass savings on; a pricing and volume-planning signal.

items.why: Signals a tracked growth category for fermented flours, directly relevant to Sapore and clean-label shelf-life ingredients.

items.title: Chocolake targets APAC markets as Dubai chocolate trend endures
items.summary: Jordan's Chocolake is expanding into Asia-Pacific as the Dubai pistachio chocolate trend persists.
items.why: Dubai-style pistachio chocolate keeps demand up for pistachio fillings and inclusions that Belcolade and Puratos fillings can supply.
